name: Systems and Control
description: Mathematical modeling: Nonlinear and Linear; State space and transfer function representation; Linearization; Block reduction; Time response and state transition matrix; Steady state error; Stability: Asymptotic and BIBO; Stability analysis: Routh-Hurwitz, Nyquist contour and Nyquist stability criterion; Gain and Phase margins; Bode plots; Root locus; Controllers: P, PI, PD, PID, Lead; Lag, Lag-Lead; Controller design using root-locus and Bode plots; Introduction to Controllability and Observability.
